question: Who among the following won the bronze medal in the men's individual recurve event at the Archery World Cup 2025 Stage 1?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dhiraj Bommadevara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhiraj Bommadevara** secured the **bronze medal** in the **men's individual recurve event** at the **Archery World Cup 2025 Stage 1**.
 
• This event is a part of the prestigious **Archery World Cup series**, which showcases the top archers from around the world.
 
• Dhiraj’s achievement is significant as it highlights the growing presence of **Indian athletes** in international archery competitions.
 
• He competed against some of the **world’s best archers** and displayed exceptional skill and determination to claim the bronze medal.
 
• This victory contributes to India’s reputation as a rising powerhouse in the field of **archery**.
 
• His success can inspire many aspiring athletes to pursue excellence in **sports**, particularly in archery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Abhishek Verma**__

 __
 
• **Abhishek Verma** is an Indian archer who specializes in the **compound category**, not the recurve category.
 
• He has won multiple medals in international events, including the **Asian Games** and World Cups, in the compound discipline.
 
 
 
• **Tarundeep Rai**__
 __
 
• **Tarundeep Rai** is a veteran Indian archer who has represented India in several international competitions in the **recurve category**.
 
• He has previously won **silver medals** in the Asian Games but did not win the bronze medal in the 2025 World Cup Stage 1.
 
 
 
• **Atanu Das**__
 
 
• **Atanu Das** is another prominent Indian recurve archer known for his performances in events like the **Olympics** and World Cups.
 
• He is a key figure in Indian archery but was not the one who won the bronze medal in this particular event.
